surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Single-page libadwaita preferences dialog with standard rows for theme, word wrap, and line numbers.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Rows stay vertically stacked and remain usable without horizontal scrolling.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Standard shortcuts window grouped into file, tab, search, and app actions.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Shortcut groups continue stacking in reading order as width tightens.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Single-window editor shell with a header bar, a runtime-inserted search bar above the tabs, a tabbed workspace, and a bottom status bar.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Header actions stay reachable while the search rows stack compactly above the tabs and the bottom status bar keeps file state on the left with cursor position on the right.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Centered window title reflects the selected tab title and subtitle while search and status chrome are added outside the title area.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: The title truncates naturally before it displaces primary header-bar actions.
